goal: Fix general amplitude and numerical issues, validate them, then complete a bounded real six-component TAU generator training run with nonzero optimizer updates, checkpoints, and before/after evidence.

task: Bidirectional distance from six AVQI components to same-speaker clean pathological CS/SV targets; preserve full-band speech and denoising.
dataset: Existing hash-sealed 20-speaker TAU diagnostic cohort. Reuse the fixed data, no speaker or recipe replacement; all speakers historically opened.
split: Use the 4 surrogate_calibration patients for training, the 4 surrogate_holdout patients for validation, and retain the 12 joint-reserve speakers for evaluation only. Never train on any held-out row.
baseline: S3_500 checkpoint, existing per-input 0.9 normalization, native ISTFT lengths; opt-in differentiable utterance-constant output attenuation to peak <=0.95.
changes: Numerically stable Softplus, shared output-peak safeguard, versioned training protocol, six real waveform-gradient backpropagation through the generator.
primary_metric: Before/after Exact Praat normalized component gaps to sealed same-speaker clean targets; no fixed-direction healthification.
guardrails: Finite magnitude, phase, output, losses and parameter gradients; waveform peak, full-band/low-frequency/airflow/pause/CS-SV/denoising checks; no high-pass in emitted audio.
expected_failure_modes: Magnitude overflow or underflow, amplitude overshoot, detached graph, incompatible topology, gradient conflict, GPU launch or checkpoint issues.
unacceptable_mistakes: Fake training, zero optimizer updates passed off as training, data leakage, SVD data tests, hiding or overwriting historical failures, lowering scientific thresholds to claim promotion.
next_experiment: Regression tests and real 104-waveform peak safety validation; recompute train-only weights, confirm all six waveform and generator gradients, then execute 128 real updates and evaluate frozen pre/post outputs.
rollback: Keep original NO_GO receipts and checkpoints immutable; stop invalid updates, preserve a last valid checkpoint, repair the cause and resume under a versioned receipt.
